title: MACP decision-receipt test vector
description: A reference vector for RFC-MACP-0013 Appendix A. It pins a receipt, the keys the verifier trusts, and the Appendix A.4 outcomes a conforming verifier returns. `receipt` is deliberately not held to macp-decision-receipt.schema.json here, because some vectors carry receipts a verifier must refuse; scripts/validate-json.sh validates every receipt whose receipt_format is macp-receipt/1 against that schema separately.

name.description: Vector identifier; MUST match the file's basename (without .json).

trusted_keys.description: kid -> Ed25519 public key as a JWK `x` (base64url, no padding). A verifier trusts exactly these keys.

integrity.description: Appendix A.4 step 2. null only when the receipt is refused at step 1.

attestations.description: One outcome per entry of receipt.attestations, in order. Empty when integrity is not match: a mismatch ends verification.

verdict.description: attested: integrity match and at least one valid attestation. integrity_only: integrity match and none valid. unverified: integrity mismatch or cannot_verify. refused: unknown receipt_format.
